name: Tempester n°40: the Pad Function mode sent on Remote Pad OUT (CC 106 = mode 0-5)
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9b (patch/nrpn_emission.json) for its SENDCC routine at 0x9d07a504. Why: the app inferred the Pad Function mode from the four mode LEDs of n°22, waiting for them to settle (the machine turns them off, then on again). The mode is bits 2-5 of the byte [address] (0 16 Beats, 1 16 Time Steps, 2 16 Sounds, 3 16 Tunings, 4 16 Mutes, 5 16 Levels), written by [routine] (2 at boot) and [routine] (the Pad Function keys). Report: the main loop's call of [routine] at [address] (every pass, after the MIDI input, the Panel message and the Play List step) goes to POLL first, which compares the mode with the last one reported ([address], mode + 1, 0 = to report); when they differ, Remote Pad OUT is not Off and the DIN send ring holds at most 16 bytes, it sends CC 106 = mode on Remote Pad OUT through SENDCC (DIN B0|ch 6A mode, then USB) and records it, then makes the replaced call as a tail call. Off or a full ring: nothing sent, the mode stays to report. Whatever changes the mode (panel key, n°21 remote key) is reported; nothing sets the mode over MIDI, so there is nothing to echo. At boot the byte is 0: the first pass with Remote Pad OUT on reports the boot mode. Full state: CC 107 (n°22's request) on Remote Pad IN (0 = All), DIN or USB, clears the byte at [address] in [routine] (reached by n°22's REQUEST, before n°31's RX; the event is published as before), so the mode is reported again on that main-loop pass. RAM: [address] only, in the .bss hole reached by nothing in 1.6.3.0. 38 words at 0x9d07b500-0x9d07b597. Proof: tools/sim_pad_mode.py and its counter-proofs; Docs/analyses/feature-identity-mode.md.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07b500 ; main loop: was "jal [address]" ([routine]), made by POLL as a tail call; delay slot "nop" kept
j 0x9d07b564 ; [routine]: was "lui t0,0x9d07" (redone at REQUEST); delay slot "sb a0,0x8(v0)" kept
addiu sp,sp,-0x18 ; main loop only. Live: ra = main; a call site, so every caller-saved register is free
lbu t0,-0x7b1c(gp) ; [address]: Pad Function mode in bits 2-5
lbu t2,-0x7c90(gp) ; [address]: mode last reported + 1 (0 = to report)
lbu t3,0x49ec(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad OUT [address] (0 = Off)
beq t3,zero,0x9d07b558 ; Off: nothing sent, still to report
lhu t4,-0x7e68(gp) ; delay slot: DIN send ring write index [address]
beq t4,zero,0x9d07b558 ; more than 16 bytes waiting: next pass
sb t1,-0x7c90(gp) ; reported (main loop only, as REQUEST)
jal 0x9d07a504 ; SENDCC(channel, 106, mode) of nrpn_emission: DIN B0|ch 6A mode, then USB
or a2,t0,zero ; delay slot: value = mode
j [address] ; [routine]: the replaced call, as a tail call (its v0 goes back to main)
lui t0,0x9d07 ; replaced instruction (t0 is read at [address]). Live: a0 = status, a1 = channel, a2 = controller, v0 = event
lbu t3,0x49eb(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad IN [address] (0 = All), the rule of n°22's request
sb zero,-0x7c90(gp) ; [address] = 0: the mode is reported again on this main-loop pass
